cases.name: a-plain-vertex
cases.text:
VERT
DCL IN[0]
DCL IN[1]
DCL IN[2]
DCL OUT[0], POSITION
DCL OUT[1], GENERIC[0]
DCL TEMP[0..117]
DCL CONST[0..45]
IMM[0] FLT32 {2,0,1,0.5}
IMM[1] FLT32 {0.125,4,0.25,0.75}
IMM[2] UINT32 {23,127,4294967200,1}
IMM[3] UINT32 {2147483648,0,2143289345,0}

UIF CONST[45].xxxx
MOV TEMP[0].x, IMM[0].xxxx
MOV TEMP[1], IN[2].xyxy
MOV TEMP[2], IMM[1].zzzz
ELSE
MOV TEMP[0].x, IMM[0].yyyy
MOV TEMP[2], IMM[1].zzzz
ENDIF
FSLT TEMP[3].x, TEMP[0].xxxx, IMM[1].xxxx

OR TEMP[5].x, TEMP[3].xxxx, TEMP[4].xxxx

ADD TEMP[7].x, IMM[0].wwww, TEMP[6].xxxx
DIV TEMP[8].x, TEMP[7].xxxx, TEMP[0].xxxx
UCMP TEMP[9].x, TEMP[5].xxxx, IMM[0].yyyy, TEMP[8].xxxx
LRP TEMP[10], TEMP[9].xxxx, TEMP[1], TEMP[2]
FSNE TEMP[11].x, TEMP[9].xxxx, IMM[0].yyyy
UCMP TEMP[117], TEMP[11].xxxx, TEMP[10], TEMP[2]
USHR TEMP[100].x, IN[1].xxxx, IMM[2].xxxx
AND TEMP[100].x, TEMP[100].xxxx, IMM[2].yyyy
UADD TEMP[100].x, TEMP[100].xxxx, IMM[2].zzzz
USHR TEMP[115], TEMP[117], TEMP[100].xxxx
AND TEMP[115], TEMP[115], IMM[2].wwww
UCMP TEMP[115], TEMP[115], IMM[0].zzzz, IMM[0].yyyy
MOV OUT[1], TEMP[115]
MOV OUT[0], IN[0]
END
